$comment: Model-fragile prompt-phrase list (BACKLOG-0091 / STORY-24.1.02 / ADR-0104). Consumed by lib/prompt-lint.js and wired into validate-frontmatter.js as warn-tier rule W4 (non-fatal, ADR-0061 — never fails pm:lint). Data-driven by design: extend this list to track future Anthropic model-guide updates WITHOUT touching validator code (STORY-24.1.02 AC-2). Each entry carries exactly one of `phrase` (literal substring match) or `pattern` (JS RegExp source string, optionally paired with a `flags` string, e.g. "i" for case-insensitive — omit for no flags). `reason` is the one-clause explanation cited in every warning. `replacement` is the migration-safe alternative documented in the 'Cross-model prompt language' section of 90-Standards/CLAUDE-CODE-CONFIG.md — keep the two lists in sync when either changes. Matching stance: literal phrases are CASE-SENSITIVE by design — 'ALWAYS use' must stay scoped to the shouty-caps imperative anti-pattern and must NOT flag ordinary lowercase prose like '...always use the strongest model' (STORY-24.1.02 gotcha, proven by TC-01's gate-language fixture and the corpus-clean requirement).
